newsitem.title: USA: NYPA sees Fitzpatrick NY nuke plant back this week.
newsitem.headline: NYPA sees Fitzpatrick NY nuke plant back this week.

text.p: The New York Power Authority (NYPA) said Monday its 832 megawatt (MW) James A Fitzpatrick nuclear power plant would resume operation later this week after a weekend restart attempt was halted.
"We're going to be back later this week," an on-site NYPA spokesman said.
He added engineers began repairing a leak in the plant's electrical hydraulic control system, which led the utility to shut the plant from 30 percent power Sunday.
The Fitzpatrick generating station in Scriba, N.Y., was in process of returning to service after a 47-day refueling and maintenance outage.
